violation_type.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))
violation_type.short_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors
violation_type.typical_finding: Fire Safety documentation was not available.

finding_variants.text: Fire Safety documentation was not available.
During inspection the emergency drills and detector monitoring was unavailable.
The operation did not have safety documentation for emergency drills, fire extinguishers, and smoke detectors available for review.
The operation has not documented any drills conducted since November of 2024.
During the inspection, records showed the operation did not have updated emergency practices compleated for multiple months.

Based on the documentation provided the fire drill has not been practiced since September 11th. The operation has not documented any emergency drills, smoke detector, and/or the carbon monoxide detector check.
